compile.what: the summary counter contract compiles and runs against the generated Prisma client
compile.test: turns the grouped rows into the client counters

compile.what: the SLA summary SQL contract compiles and buckets every flag combination
compile.test: buckets every flag combination and adds it to the totals

compile.what: the dashboard aggregation contract compiles and keeps KPI parity
compile.test: returns KPI parity for scoped tickets in the report window

compile.what: the trends bucket builder compiles and aligns ISO weeks across both DST changes
compile.test: aligns ISO weeks to Monday 00:00 local across both DST changes

compile.what: the pack service compiles and exports without leaking a sibling unit
compile.test: exports monthly KPI JSON without sibling OU tickets

compile.what: the schedule limit spec compiles and exercises the real PostgreSQL lock
compile.test: refuses the next save at the limit and frees the slot when a schedule is deleted

compile.what: the run tombstone spec compiles and keeps the snapshot contract
compile.test: rejects a run without the schedule snapshot

compile.what: the version/CAS spec compiles and does not let the runner bump the version
compile.test: does not bump the version when the runner records a run

compile.what: the audit-atomicity spec compiles and rolls the run back with a failed audit
compile.test: rolls the run finalization back when the audit row cannot be written

compile.what: the run-now idempotency spec compiles and refuses a repeated command key
compile.test: refuses a second run for the same command key

compile.what: the delivery crash-window spec compiles and records SMTP acceptance evidence
compile.test: records the SMTP acceptance evidence when nothing crashes

compile.what: the scheduler reconciliation spec compiles and registers one schedule for two workers
compile.test: registers exactly one schedule when two workers start against the same Redis

corpus.what: a corpus above the budget is capped and the truncation is reported
corpus.test: caps scoped tickets at the row budget and reports the truncation

corpus.what: the reader asks the database for budget + 1 rows, never the whole period
corpus.test: reads only budget + 1 rows from the database

corpus.what: the preview returns one page and labels the count as a lower bound
corpus.test: previews at most one page and labels the count as a lower bound

scope.what: a parent unit, a sibling branch and a mere string prefix are all refused
scope.test: refuses a parent, a sibling branch and a prefix that is only a string prefix

scope.what: the refusal names the offending field and answers the same way for unknown and foreign
scope.test: reports the field that broke the scope, and nothing when the schedule has no group

scope.what: a legacy row with a foreign group never prints that group's name
scope.test: omits a foreign group name from the e-mail scope line of a legacy row (W7.93)

concurrency.what: two saves arriving together cannot take one slot twice
concurrency.test: lets exactly one of two concurrent saves take the last slot

concurrency.what: two saves from the same version: exactly one wins
concurrency.test: lets exactly one of two saves from the same version win

concurrency.what: delete only applies to the version the caller was shown
concurrency.test: deletes only the version the caller was shown

concurrency.what: many concurrent jobs for one command key produce exactly one run
concurrency.test: lets exactly one of many concurrent jobs for one command win

concurrency.what: the runner treats the duplicate manual run as a no-op instead of composing
concurrency.test: executes one manual run per command key and treats the duplicate as a no-op

concurrency.what: a slot already claimed by another worker is not sent twice
concurrency.test: never sends twice when another worker already claimed the slot

redis.what: a missing client and a throwing client both degrade to a cache miss
redis.test: degrades to a miss without Redis and when Redis throws

redis.what: the dashboard keeps answering when Redis errors
a wiped Redis only costs a recomputation, never a wrong number
redis.test: shares one computation between concurrent misses and serves later hits from Redis

redis.what: losing the scheduler registration is repaired by the reconcile pass
redis.test: restores the five-minute sweep after Redis loses the registration

smtp.what: an accepted receipt that cannot be persisted becomes an unknown outcome, not a resend
smtp.test: records an unknown delivery outcome when the accepted SMTP receipt cannot be persisted

smtp.what: a lost SENT mark leaves a CLAIMED row and the report is never sent twice
smtp.test: leaves a CLAIMED row when the SENT mark is lost, and never sends that report twice

smtp.what: a fresh claim answers DUPLICATE instead of sending again
smtp.test: answers DUPLICATE for a claim that is still fresh instead of sending again

smtp.what: a stale claim is treated as unknown, never as an invitation to resend
smtp.test: treats a stale delivery claim as an unknown outcome instead of resending (at-least-once)

smtp.what: only eligible recipients are addressed, and the skipped ones are recorded
smtp.test: sends only to eligible recipients and records the skipped ones

failure.what: an unauditable preview serves no rows (fail-closed read audit)
failure.test: fails closed: an unauditable preview serves no rows

failure.what: a retention database error reaches the caller instead of being swallowed
failure.test: lets a database error reach the caller instead of swallowing it

failure.what: a retention failure reaches BullMQ so the job is retried and alarmed
failure.test: lets a retention failure reach BullMQ (no silent swallow)

failure.what: a missing schedule is reported instead of pretending a run happened
failure.test: reports a missing schedule instead of pretending a run happened

retention.what: only runs older than the window are deleted, and the cutoff is reported
retention.test: deletes only runs older than the retention window and reports the cutoff

retention.what: deleting a schedule keeps its run log until the retention window passes
retention.test: keeps the run log when its schedule is deleted and detaches it from the row

retention.what: retention still runs when scheduled e-mail delivery is switched off
retention.test: prunes the run log even when scheduled delivery is switched off (W7.103)

privacy.what: the privacy matrix covers every report model the schema defines
privacy.test: covers every report model in the schema

privacy.what: anonymization detaches the manual trigger without touching the run's facts
privacy.test: detaches the manual trigger without touching the run’s facts

privacy.what: a full erasure scrubs the report footprint on a real database
privacy.test: executes: scrubs content, deletes personal rows, pseudonymises the user

attachments.what: CSV attachments are built from the schedule slice, not from the whole unit
attachments.test: builds CSV attachments from the schedule slice, not the whole unit

attachments.what: a pack that cannot apply the slice is omitted instead of being widened
attachments.test: omits a pack that cannot apply the schedule slice instead of widening it

attachments.what: time-tracking entries are sliced through their ticket, one hop away
attachments.test: applies the slice to time tracking entries through their ticket
